_comment: Golden-master corpus: the actual clips published by successful CI runs.
These are the reproduction assets for the visual defects found in the
AGENTS.md compliance audit. Each entry records what a human sees when
scrubbing the timeline, so the verifier's verdict can be checked against
ground truth rather than against itself.
The MP4s are NOT tracked in git (~140 MB). Fetch them with:
Every file is verified by SHA-256 on fetch. A hash mismatch is a hard error:
a silently different fixture would make every visual regression test lie.

defects: B3 caption_on_face: caption baseline at y~490/1920 = 25.5% of frame height, directly across the subject's eyebrows and eyes
B4 hook_badge: the two-line badge renders as two staggered, overlapping plates forming a jagged staircase block; not a capsule

human_assessment.layout: portrait_face, collapsing into a broken two-pane split at the end
defects: B2 freeze: freezedetect n=0.003 d=0.5 reports THREE events - 41.1s (0.533s), 41.633s (0.6s), 42.867s (0.5s) - 1.63s cumulative frozen video, 3.7% of the clip, in the published artifact
B1 pillarbox: the frozen segment renders each pane at 540x960 (9:16, not 9:8) at x=270..809, leaving 270px of pure black on each side = 50% of frame width dead
B3 caption_on_divider: caption at y~960, exactly on the pane divider
notes: QA reported passed=True on this clip. The freeze events are all below the 0.8s max_freeze_duration gate, and no black-bar check exists.

human_assessment.layout: portrait_face for most of the clip; a blur_stack slide occupies roughly the final 0.4s
defects: A20 av_structural_drift: audio stream is +116.7ms longer than the video stream (start delta 0.0ms). Invisible on a visual scrub. AGENTS.md 3.2 claims 0ms.
notes: NON-BLOCKING GEOMETRY OBSERVATION: geometry.analyse reports worst_vertical_bar_pct=4.1% over the last 7 of 240 samples. Inspected the frame at t=50.0s by hand: this is the blur_stack layout's blurred background, which is a near-black coffee-cup line pattern (per-column max 0-6) and is DESIGNED to be dark. Not padding, not a defect.
This is why the geometry check is graded (WARNING_BAR_PCT=3.0, BLOCKING_BAR_PCT=8.0) rather than binary. A naive content-box detector flags any blur_stack shot by construction.

B19 (found during verification, not in the original audit): the final blur_stack shot renders a screenshot of a news-article page whose headline is cropped mid-word at the left edge ('...l Disney Channel' / '...er star is accused of' / '...mare neighbor'), on a blurred background, with the burned caption 'I JUST' sitting mid-frame at roughly 74% height. The slide content is CROPPED rather than FIT, so on-screen text is cut off. Confirmed by full-resolution frame extraction.

SUPERSEDED BY VERIFIER -- this is the corpus's one remaining human/verifier disagreement, and the verifier is right. Visually the clip looked clean, so it was recorded as PASS. av_sync then found the audio stream is +117ms longer than the video (start delta 0.0ms, so the drift accumulates across the clip, the signature of a resampling or re-encode stage rather than a seeking bug). That is invisible on a scrub and is a real AGENTS.md 3.2 violation. The verdict below is updated to FAIL to match, and the original visual assessment is preserved here for provenance.

synthetic.why: A 3s 1920x1080 source holding one still frame. The canonical reproduction for the freeze class of defect; render it through any static renderer branch and freezedetect must report nothing.
A textured 1920x1080 source. Used where a still frame would make freezedetect ambiguous because there is genuinely no motion to detect.
